The purple block in the HUD at the top (4-6, 30-32): stationary so far.
The ball with the gray core: stationary.
Maybe the game is like this: the ball is fired (automatically?) along the line, and the purple block is a "paddle" that the ball bounces off of. The goal is to bounce the ball to... hit the purple block in the HUD? Or to get the ball to the bottom?
Wait — maybe the ball moves when the purple block is at the correct position? Or maybe the ball moves every N actions?
Let me look at the dots on the line: from (19,42) to (57,6). Actually, let me check whether the line is a "track" and the ball is at one end. The ball is at the top-right end of the line. The line extends to the bottom-left, ending at (57,6), with the next implied points being (59,4),(61,2),(63,0) — the bottom-left corner where the white bar is.
Hypothesis A: The ball rolls down the line every turn (or when fired). The purple block is a bumper on the line. When the ball hits the purple block, it bounces back up the line. Goal: bounce the ball to... the top? Or hit the purple block in the HUD?
But the ball hasn't moved in 2 actions. So it's not automatic per turn.
Hypothesis B: The white bar is a "power" bar, and the ball is fired with ACTION7 (unavailable). The goal is to place the purple block at the correct position on the line so that the ball, when fired, bounces and hits the target (the purple block in the HUD?).
Since ACTION7 can't be executed by name, maybe the ball is fired by clicking on the ball? Let me try clicking on the ball's center (15,47).
Or, the ball is fired by clicking anywhere on the line? The first click (53,10) moved the block — but maybe it also fired the ball? The ball didn't move.
Let me try clicking on the ball.
Also, let me reconsider the "white cross" that was at (52-54, 9-11) in the initial frame. It disappeared when the purple block moved there. Maybe the cross was a "ghost" showing where the block will land? No — the block landed exactly where the cross was. Maybe the cross was a "target" for the block, and placing the block on the cross is part of the goal, but the level didn't complete.
Hmm, wait, maybe the level requires multiple placements, or the cross reappears in a different location after each placement? Let me check the current frame for the cross (a W node of about 5 pixels). In the current frame, the only W node is the bottom bar (60 pixels). No cross. So the cross is gone (covered by the block).
Let me try clicking on the ball to see if something happens.
